newsitem.title: BRAZIL: FOCUS - Brazil faces showdown over states' debts.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Brazil faces showdown over states' debts.

text.p: Brazil's government faces a showdown this week with near-bankrupt states over their rapidly-mounting billion-dollar debts, newspapers reported on Sunday.

The Folha de Sao Paulo newspaper said governors of 19 states, who last Monday declared they would abandon talks with tight-fisted Finance Ministry officials, will demand a meeting with President Fernando Henrique Cardoso this week.
Among their demands will be a three-month moratorium on interest payments on federal loans.
